name: haus-bench
description: Benchmarks: haus against JSON on real data: size, tokens and compression (size/), TypeScript speed (speed/ts/); Rust speed is speed/rust/ (cargo bench)

scripts.convert: pnpm run prepare-haus && node main.node.ts convert
scripts.speed: pnpm run prepare-haus && node --expose-gc main.node.ts speed
scripts.all: pnpm run prepare-haus && node --use-env-proxy --expose-gc main.node.ts all
scripts.smoke: pnpm run prepare-haus && node --use-env-proxy --expose-gc main.node.ts smoke
